scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Eh...?
A Novice?
Still thinking
what job you're
gonna choose...
Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
呃...？
一個初心者？
還在糾結要選什麼職業...
我猜得沒錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Whaaaat are you
doin' here? There's
nothing I can teach you!
You're waaay beyond me!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
你...你在這兒幹嘛？
我沒什麼能教你的！
你完全超出我的能力範圍了！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Heya pal.
I'm Yierhan.
I happen to be
the guy in charge
of training new Thieves.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
嘿，朋友。
我是葉爾汗。
我正好是負責訓練新盜賊的人。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright, enough about stats.
You know what? I think I'll just talk to you about the skills that we Thieves use.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
好了，屬性什麼的就不多說了。
你知道嗎？我覺得還是聊聊我們盜賊使用的技能比較好。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Okay, let me see your skills. You know you gotta change your battle strategy depending on what skills you have, right? Skills are just as important as stats!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
好，讓我看看你的技能。你知道要根據擁有的技能來改變戰鬥策略，對吧？技能和屬性一樣重要！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So...
Are there any
skills you want
explained or is this
pretty much stuff you
already know?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
那麼...
有沒有什麼你想了解的技能？還是說這些你都已經知道了？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright, we studied the skills and you've been practicing a little, right? You better have...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
好了，我們研究了技能，你也稍微練習了一下，對吧？你最好已經...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
'Ey, you don't have the 10 ^ff0000Feather of Birds^000000 I asked you for! You gotta apply what you know, you know.
Now hurry up and do it!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
喂，你沒有我讓你找的10個^ff0000鳥羽^000000！你得把學到的東西付諸實踐啊。
快去快回！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright...!
Nice work, pal.
Seeing as you got these feathers, you must be really gung-ho about becoming a good Thief.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
很好...！
幹得漂亮，朋友。
既然你能找到這些羽毛，看來你是真的想成為一名優秀的盜賊。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
[Yierhan]
You know...
There was this
fight that was in
the Southern part
of this town.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
[葉爾汗]
你知道嗎...
之前在這個城鎮的南部發生過一場戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Heya pal.
You doin' alright?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
嘿，朋友。
你還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I heard there was
this one Assassin
that went on a mission
and never returned.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
我聽說有一個刺客去執行任務後就沒有回來。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
'Ey, did you
complete your mission?
I know, I know, the thing you've gotta do is pretty rough.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
喂，你完成任務了嗎？
我知道，我知道，你要做的事情確實很棘手。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
[Yierhan]
Hey...
You got dreams,
don't you? I know,
it's a bit of a deep
subject I pulled outta
nowhere, but...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
[葉爾汗]
嘿...
你有夢想，對吧？我知道，我這個問題有點突兀，但是...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
[Yierhan]
Heya.
I'm the Thief trainer around here. Sure, it looks like we don't got much in common, but...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
[葉爾汗]
嘿。
我是這裡的盜賊訓練師。雖然看起來我們沒什麼共同點，但是...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Hm...?
That's weird, usually only
Thieves hang around this joint. What's someone like you doing
here? Unless...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
嗯...？
真奇怪，通常只有盜賊會在這個地方徘徊。像你這樣的人為什麼會在這裡？除非...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So how's the
investigation
coming along?
I've been so busy,
I couldn't focus
on it at all...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
那麼...
調查進展如何？
我太忙了，完全沒顧得上...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Just as I thought,
more than one group
was involved in all this.
Huh. Something real bad
might happen soon...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
果然，牽涉到不止一個組織。
嗯。恐怕很快就會發生很糟糕的事情...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So...
Are there any
skills you want
explained or is this
pretty much stuff you
already know?
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
那麼...
有沒有什麼你想了解的技能？還是說這些你都已經知道了？
有些人覺得沙漠只是一個危險、不舒服且沒人想去的地方。但這裡其實有很多很棒的東西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
有些人覺得沙漠只是一個危險、不舒服且沒人想去的地方。但這裡其實有很多很棒的東西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Listen, if you ever decide to become a Thief--a smart choice
I might add--come and talk to me. I'll show you the ropes!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
聽著，如果你決定成為一名盜賊——順便說一句，這是個明智的選擇——就來找我聊聊吧。我會教你入門的！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
In fact, I think
you're qualified
to teach me some stuff!
Come on! I need new moves!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
事實上，我覺得你完全有資格教我一些東西！
來吧！我需要學些新招式！

scripts.text: Training?
scripts.translation: 訓練？

scripts.text: Training? Right now?
scripts.translation: 訓練？現在？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Yeah, training. I mean, this kind of stuff is second nature to some people, but other guys need a little more help. So this is one of those 'just in case' things.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
沒錯，訓練。我是說，對有些人來說，這些技能已經是本能了，但其他人可能需要多一點幫助。所以這是一種“以防萬一”的準備。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Right now?
Yeah, right now!
But if you're not ready for some reason, I guess I can wait.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
現在？
沒錯，就是現在！
不過如果你因為某些原因還沒準備好，我想我可以等等。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright, first of all, Thieves use melee attacks. Well, most of us do. There are a few who like using long range Bows. But all of us are good at bein' fast!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
好吧，首先，盜賊主要使用近戰攻擊。嗯，大多數人都這樣。也有少數人喜歡使用遠端的弓。但我們所有人都擅長快速移動！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So for melee attacks, which stat increases your damage? Come on
now, you should know this if you didn't skip the Novice Training Grounds.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
那麼對於近戰攻擊，哪個屬效能增加你的傷害？來吧，如果你沒有跳過訓練場，你應該知道這個。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Say whaaat? ^6B8E23INT^000000 affects magic damage, magic defense and some skills. Thieves don't even work with magic!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
你說什麼？^6B8E23INT^000000影響的是魔法傷害、魔法防禦和一些技能。盜賊甚至不使用魔法！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You musta skipped the Novice Training Grounds altogether! Not that I blame you though. Anyway, it's ^2F4F2FSTR^000000 that increases your attack damage, got it?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
你肯定是完全跳過了訓練場！不過我不怪你。總之，是^2F4F2FSTR^000000增加你的攻擊傷害，明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So if you're feeling like the damage you're making is pretty weak, you might want more stat points in ^2F4F2FSTR^000000. How high your raise your own STR is really up to you.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
所以如果你覺得你的傷害很弱，你可能需要在^2F4F2FSTR^000000上投入更多的屬性點。你要把STR加到多高，完全由你自己決定。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Yeah, that's right! If you wanna increase your damage, you need
to put some stat points into ^2F4F2FSTR^000000. Increasing STR also increases
your Max Weight Limit too.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
沒錯，就是這樣！如果你想增加傷害，你需要把一些屬性點加到^2F4F2FSTR^000000上。提高STR也會增加你的最大負重上限。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So if you're feeling like the damage you're making is pretty weak, you might want more stat points in ^2F4F2FSTR^000000. How high your raise your own STR is really up to you.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
所以如果你覺得你的傷害很弱，你可能需要在^2F4F2FSTR^000000上投入更多的屬性點。你要把STR加到多高，完全由你自己決定。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Sure, ^23238EDEX^000000 and LUK can
also increase your attack damage, but they're insignificant compared to STR. I repeat: ^660000insignificant^000000.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
當然，^23238EDEX^000000和LUK也能增加你的攻擊傷害，但與STR相比，它們微不足道。我再說一遍：^660000微不足道^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Say whaaat? ^23238EDEX^000000 affects
your attack accuracy, not your damage! Well, unless you're using
a Bow. Otherwise, it increases your damage only by a tiny bit.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
你說什麼？^23238EDEX^000000影響的是你的攻擊命中率，而不是傷害！除非你在使用弓。否則，它只會稍微增加一點點傷害。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You musta skipped the Novice Training Grounds altogether! Not that I blame you though. Anyway, it's ^2F4F2FSTR^000000 that increases your attack damage, got it?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
你肯定是完全跳過了訓練場！不過我不怪你。總之，是^2F4F2FSTR^000000增加你的攻擊傷害，明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So if you're feeling like the damage you're making is pretty weak, you might want more stat points in ^2F4F2FSTR^000000. How high your raise your own STR is really up to you.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
所以如果你覺得你的傷害很弱，你可能需要在^2F4F2FSTR^000000上投入更多的屬性點。你要把STR加到多高，完全由你自己決定。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So level up your skills, learn a few new ones if you want, and
then come back over here.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
所以去提升你的技能等級，如果想學幾個新技能就學吧，然後回到這裡來。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You haven't learned any skills yet? Come on, it's your skills that'll set you apart from Novices and everyone else!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
你還沒學任何技能？拜託，正是技能讓你與初心者和其他人區分開來！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Ah, so you've learned
Level {0} Double Attack.
Nice! This skill gives you the chance to attack twice in one
attack. Wicked!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
啊，所以你學會了等級{0}的二刀連擊。
不錯！這個技能讓你有機會在一次攻擊中攻擊兩次。太酷了！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
It's a Passive skill, so it's always in effect and won't have to use any SP to use it. The higher your Double Attack skill level, the more double attacks you'll do.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
這是被動技能，所以它始終生效，使用時不需要消耗SP。你的二刀連擊等級越高，觸發連擊的次數就越多。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Let's see...
Level {0} Increase Dodge?
That increases your Flee Rate, meaning you've got a better chance of dodging attacks from your enemies.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
讓我看看...
等級{0}的殘影？
這會增加你的閃避率，意味著你有更好的機會躲避敵人的攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Just like the Double Attack skill, Increase Dodge is a Passive skill. It won't use SP and it's always in
effect. If you don't like to bruise, this is your skill.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
就像二刀連擊一樣，殘影也是被動技能。它不消耗SP，且始終生效。如果你不想捱打，這就是你的技能。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Whoa, so you've
got Level {0} Steal~
Now that's the skill which gives our job its name! You can't use
it against people, though...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
哇，你居然有等級{0}的偷竊~
這可是讓我們這個職業得名的技能！不過，你不能對人使用它...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
But you can use Steal to take items from monsters. If you're lucky, you can get some good items that way. Oh, and Steal doesn't affect monster drop rates.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
但你可以用偷竊從魔物身上奪取物品。如果你運氣好，就能獲得一些不錯的物品。哦，對了，偷竊不會影響魔物的掉落率。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You've learned
Level {0} Hiding?
Let's see, you can only learn
that after learning the Steal skill up to a certain level.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
你學會了等級{0}的隱匿？
讓我看看，你只有在將偷竊技能學到一定等級後，才能學習這個技能。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Of course, you use 
the Hiding skill to hide underground in an emergency, like when you're surrounded by tough enemies. Be careful though...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
當然，當你被強大的敵人包圍等緊急情況下，你可以使用隱匿技能躲到地下。不過要小心...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Certain monsters will still be able to find you, no matter how well you hide. There are even a few monsters that can flush you out of hiding!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
某些魔物無論你怎麼躲藏都能找到你。甚至有一些魔物能把你從隱匿狀態中揪出來！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright, I see that you
know Level {0} Envenom.
You like being dangerous,
don't you?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
好吧，我看到你知道等級{0}的施毒。
你喜歡危險，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
This attack skill has the chance
to poison your enemy for a set amount of time. While poisoned, an enemy will constantly lose its HP and will have decreased defense.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
這個攻擊技能有機會使敵人在一定時間內中毒。中毒的敵人會持續損失HP，並且防禦力下降。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Eh, but remember.
If the monster's too strong for you, you might not be able to poison it. So don't go crazy.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
呃，但請記住。
如果魔物比你強太多，你可能無法讓它中毒。所以別太沖動。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Level {0} Detoxify.
If you took the trouble to learn that, you must be the cautious
type or something.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
等級{0}的解毒。
如果你費心學了這個，那你一定是個謹慎的人，或者什麼的。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You can only learn Detoxify
after you learn the Envenom skill. Detoxify allows you to counteract the effects of poison on a target.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
你只有在學會施毒技能後，才能學習解毒。解毒可以消除目標身上的中毒效果。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright, I guess
if you want to know
about any other skills,
I can explain real quick.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
好吧，我想如果你想知道其他任何技能，我可以快速解釋一下。

scripts.text: Double Attack
scripts.translation: 二刀連擊

scripts.text: Increase Dodge
scripts.translation: 殘影

scripts.text: Steal
scripts.translation: 偷竊

scripts.text: Hiding
scripts.translation: 隱匿

scripts.text: Envenom
scripts.translation: 施毒

scripts.text: Detoxify
scripts.translation: 解毒

scripts.text: I know enough.
scripts.translation: 我瞭解得夠多了

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Just like its name,
Double Attack gives your attacks the chance to be a double attack, two strikes in one blow.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
顧名思義，二刀連擊讓你的攻擊有機會變成連擊，即一次攻擊造成兩次打擊。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
It's a Passive skill, so it's always in effect and won't have to use any SP to use it. The higher your Double Attack skill level, the more double attacks you'll do.
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
這是被動技能，所以它始終處於生效狀態，且不需要消耗SP。你的二刀連擊技能等級越高，觸發連擊的次數就越多。
有些人覺得沙漠只是一個危險、令人不適且沒人想去的地方。
但這裡其實有各種各樣很棒的東西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Increase Dodge
gives a nice boost
to your Flee Rate that
the other jobs don't offer.
Why take your lumps when you
can avoid them altogether?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
殘影能極大地提高你的閃避率，這是其他職業所不具備的優勢。
既然可以完全避開攻擊，何必硬挨呢？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Just like the Double Attack skill, Increase Dodge is a Passive skill. It won't use SP and it's always in
effect. If you don't like to bruise, this is your skill.
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
和二刀連擊一樣，殘影也是被動技能。它不消耗SP，且始終處於生效狀態。如果你不想捱打，這就是你的技能。
有些人覺得沙漠只是一個危險、令人不適且沒人想去的地方。
但這裡其實有各種各樣很棒的東西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Steal is an Active Skill that has the chance of nabbing you some
free items! You can't use it against other people, though.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
偷竊是一個主動技能，有機會讓你白撿一些物品！不過，你不能對其他人使用它。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
But you can use Steal to take items from monsters! If you're lucky, you can get some good items that way. Oh, and Steal doesn't affect monster drop rates.
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
但你確實可以用偷竊從魔物身上獲取物品！如果你運氣好，就能得到不錯的物品。哦，對了，偷竊不會影響魔物的掉落率。
有些人覺得沙漠只是一個危險、令人不適且沒人想去的地方。
但這裡其實有各種各樣很棒的東西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Hiding is an active skill where you submerge yourself underground. You can only stay hidden so long, and you can't move, but sometimes it's better than being found!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
隱匿是一個主動技能，讓你潛入地下。你只能隱藏一段時間，且無法移動，但有時候這比被發現要好得多！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Of course, you use 
the Hiding skill to hide underground in an emergency, like when you're surrounded by tough enemies. Be careful though...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
當然，當你被強大的敵人包圍等緊急情況下，你可以使用隱匿技能躲到地下。不過要小心...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Certain monsters will still be able to find you, no matter how well you hide. There are even a few monsters that can flush you out of hiding!
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
某些魔物無論你怎麼隱藏都能找到你。甚至有一些魔物能把你從隱匿狀態中揪出來！
有些人覺得沙漠只是一個危險、令人不適且沒人想去的地方。
但這裡其實有各種各樣很棒的東西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Envenom is an offensive Active Skill that every Thief should know. But that's just what I think.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
施毒是一個進攻性的主動技能，每個盜賊都應該掌握。但這只是我的看法。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
This attack skill has the chance
to poison your enemy for a set amount of time. While poisoned, an enemy will constantly lose its HP and will have decreased defense.
Remember that.
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
這個攻擊技能有機會使敵人在一定時間內中毒。中毒狀態下，敵人會持續損失HP，且防禦力下降。
記住這一點。
有些人覺得沙漠只是一個危險、令人不適且沒人想去的地方。
但這裡其實有各種各樣很棒的東西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Since Thieves deal
quite a bit with poison,
we've got to have a way
to, well, have a taste
of our own medicine.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
既然盜賊經常與毒藥打交道，我們就必須掌握一種方法，來，嗯，應付自己的毒。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You can learn Detoxify
after you learn the Envenom skill. Detoxify allows you to counteract the effects of poison on a target.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
學會施毒技能後，你可以學習解毒。解毒可以消除目標身上的中毒效果。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Yeah...
I'm tired of explaining these skills anyway. Let's move on to
the next part of Thief training...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
嗯...
反正我也講累了。讓我們進入盜賊訓練的下一部分吧...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Now that you're such an expert on skills, I want you to level up your skills and come back, got it?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
既然你現在對技能這麼精通，我希望你提升技能等級後再回來，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright, now I got some actual fight training I want you to do. Here's a chance for you to figure what skills are best for which situations.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
好了，現在我要給你一些實戰訓練。這是一個機會，讓你弄清楚在什麼情況下使用什麼技能最合適。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Go and get me
10 ^ff0000Feather of Birds^000000.
You can go ahead and kill Pickies to get those. It really shouldn't be that hard. Oh, and use this Wing thingee to come back.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
去給我弄10個^ff0000鳥羽^000000。
你可以去殺小雞來獲取它們。這真的不應該太難。哦，還有，用這個翅膀玩意兒回來。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I hope you keep
putting in the work
to get better and better.
Always do your best! Oh,
and do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
我希望你能繼續努力，變得越來越強。
永遠做到最好！哦，你還有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text: About those traces...
scripts.translation: 關於那些痕跡...

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 沒有

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You found out, eh?
Well, I didn't really
wanna tell you this, on
account of you bein' a brand
brand new Thief and all, but...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
你發現了，是嗎？
嗯，我本來真不想告訴你這些，畢竟你是個徹頭徹尾的新手盜賊，但是...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
There was this
fight that was in
the Southern part
of this town.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
在城鎮的南部發生過一場打鬥。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Since it happened late at night, only a few people actually know about it. As for me, I stayed late at a guild meeting, so it was
dumb luck that I saw it.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
因為發生在深夜，實際上知道這件事的人很少。至於我，因為參加公會會議留到了很晚，所以看到這一幕純屬巧合。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I went back to where the fight happened and I found traces that showed that the guys who were fighting went south.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
我回到打鬥發生的地方查看了一下，發現了一些痕跡，顯示打鬥的人往南邊去了。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Since poison was used in
the fight, I'm guessing an Assassin was involved, but I can't be too sure. If you wanna check it out, follow the traces of that fight.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
既然打鬥中用到了毒藥，我猜測有刺客參與，但我不能百分百確定。如果你想查清楚，就順著那些打鬥的痕跡去找吧。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Eh, but be careful
not to get too close
to the poison! That stuff
is pretty strong!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
呃，不過要小心別靠毒藥太近！那玩意兒毒性挺強的！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Good!
Less work for me!
Alright, you better get stronger the next time I see you. Oh, and you can have this stuff. You know, since you're so gangster and all.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
好！
省了我不少事！
好了，下次見到你時，你最好變強一點。哦，還有，這些給你。你知道的，誰讓你這麼有派頭呢。

scripts.text: It was nice to meet you.
scripts.translation: 很高興認識你

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 沒有

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Yeah, it was pretty cool just hanging out. Keep fighting
monsters the way you do and
you'll be a great Thief in no time.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
是啊，一起閒逛挺不錯的。繼續像現在這樣打怪，你很快就能成為出色的盜賊了。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
And since I like
you so much, kid,
you can have this.
Take it, it's yours!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
而且，既然我這麼喜歡你，小傢伙，這個給你吧。
拿著，這是你的！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Good!
Less work for me!
Alright, you better get stronger the next time I see you. Oh, and you can have this stuff. You know, since you're so gangster and all.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
好！
省了我不少事！
好了，下次見到你時，你最好變強一點。哦，還有，這些給你。你知道的，誰讓你這麼有派頭呢。

[Yierhan]

dumb luck that I saw it.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
因為發生在深夜，實際上知道這件事的人很少。至於我，因為參加公會會議留到了很晚，所以看到這一幕純屬巧合。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I went back to where the fight happened and I found traces that showed that the guys who were fighting went south.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
我回到打鬥發生的地方查看了一下，發現了一些痕跡，顯示打鬥的人往南邊去了。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]

the fight, I'm guessing an Assassin was involved, but I can't be too sure. If you wanna check it out, follow the traces of that fight.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Eh, but be careful
not to get too close
to the poison! That stuff
is pretty strong!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
呃，不過要小心別靠毒藥太近！那玩意兒毒性挺強的！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Hey, you might run into
poison, so remember that
Green Herbs and Green Potions
will counteract it. Oh, and keep in mind that Red Gemstones can
be used in poison attacks.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
嘿，你可能會遇到毒藥，所以記住綠色藥草和綠色藥水可以解毒。哦，還有，別忘了紅色魔力礦石可以用於毒攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Hey, if you do
decide to check it
out, be real careful
other there, okay?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
嘿，如果你決定去查的話，一定要非常小心，那裡很危險，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Fighting against something
you know nothing about is always risky. Since I've heard there are outsiders around flaunting their power, you better be careful.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
與完全不瞭解的東西對抗總是很危險的。既然我聽說有外人在那裡炫耀武力，你最好小心點。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
It's a good policy to just be really careful on your adventures. Look out for monsters and look
out for people! Got it?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
在冒險中保持極度謹慎是個好策略。小心魔物，也要小心人！明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
What's so weird about it was that the Assassin Guild reported that the mission was completed!
I remember hearing that guy
was really good...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
奇怪的是，刺客公會報告說任務已經完成了！
我記得聽說那個人真的很厲害...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Crazy, isn't it?
Anyway, take
care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
真瘋狂，不是嗎？
總之，照顧好自己。

scripts.text: I'm still investigating.
scripts.translation: 我還在調查中

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒有

scripts.text: Yes, I did.
scripts.translation: 是的，完成了

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Ah, gotcha. Well, that's understandable. I mean, these things take time, you know?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
啊，明白了。嗯，這很正常。畢竟，這些事情需要時間，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Yeah...?
That's alright.
I guess these kinds of things require patience. And thinking.
You know, things I'm horrible at.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
是嗎...？
沒關係。
我想這類事情需要耐心。還有思考。
你知道的，我在這方面很糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright...!
So what's up?
Hit me up with
what you know~
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
好了...！
那麼，有什麼事嗎？
把你所知道的告訴我吧~

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou explain the results of your investigation to Yierhan and tell him about the scrap of cloth you found on your mission.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向葉爾汗解釋調查的結果，並告訴他你在任務中發現的那塊布片。^000000

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Scrap of cloth?
Huh, alright. Say,
lemme have a looksee.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
布片？
嗯，好吧。喂，讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Whoa!
You did great.
This is some pretty
important information!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
哇！
你做得很棒。
這是相當重要的資訊！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You see, the pattern on this cloth is sort of like one of the codes Assassins use. And this particular pattern looks like something from one of those higher Assassins.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
你看，這塊布上的圖案有點像刺客使用的某種暗號。而這個特定的圖案，看起來像是來自某位高階刺客的。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I might be able to figure out what happened that night with the new information this cloth might lead me to. Thanks a lot!
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
有了這塊布可能帶來的新線索，我或許能弄清楚那天晚上發生了什麼。太感謝了！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
From here on,
the higher ups in the
guild will take over this investigation. You did your job perfectly, so it's time for you to hone your skills.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
從這裡開始，公會的高層將接手這項調查。你做得非常完美，是時候去磨練你的技能了。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Hey, this stuff is yours. Think of it as a reward for helping us out. Take care of yourself now~
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
嘿，這些是你的。就當是感謝你的幫忙吧。照顧好自己哦~

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I just like telling people to follow their dreams. So do it. Life without anything to look forward to is pretty boring, doncha think?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
我只是喜歡鼓勵人們去追逐夢想。所以去做吧。沒有期待的生活是很無聊的，你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I actually got a few magic using friends here and there. That mystic stuff is waaay over my head, but
I got a lotta respect for it.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
我其實有幾個會使用魔法的朋友。那些神秘的東西完全超出我的理解範圍，但我對它們充滿敬意。

scripts.text: I'm here on behalf of 'Mana.'
scripts.translation: 我是代表“瑪娜”來的

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Right, you must be the help that Mana sent! You came just at the right time. You see, we found something weird in South Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
沒錯，你就是瑪娜派來的幫手吧！你來得正是時候。你看，我們在南夢羅克發現了一些奇怪的東西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Basically, we found traces of poison that were used in a fight. We were going to investigate it, but we've been swamped with all this other work.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
基本上，我們發現了戰鬥中使用過的毒藥痕跡。我們本來打算調查的，但最近被其他工作忙得不可開交。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
That's why we've been asking
for help from the Mage Guild. Fortunately, I'm pals with Mana, so...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
所以我們一直在向魔法師公會尋求幫助。幸運的是，我和瑪娜很熟，所以...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Anyway, head over to
South Morocc since it seems to be a good place to start investigating. You'll see what we found right outside the South Morocc gate.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
總之，去南夢羅克吧，那裡似乎是開始調查的好地方。你會在南夢羅克大門外看到我們發現的痕跡。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
What's so weird about it was that the Assassin Guild reported that the mission was completed!
I remember hearing that guy
was really good...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
奇怪的是，刺客公會報告說任務已經完成了！
我記得聽說那個人真的很厲害...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Be careful, pal.
It seems your
investigation
might be related to
that mysterious Assassin...
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
小心點，夥計。
你的調查似乎與那位神秘的刺客有關...

scripts.text: I'm still investigating.
scripts.translation: 我還在調查中

scripts.text: I'm not done yet...
scripts.translation: 我還沒做完...

scripts.text: Oh, I finished~
scripts.translation: 哦，我做完了~

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Ah, gotcha. Well, that's understandable. I mean, these things take time, you know?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
啊，明白了。嗯，這很正常。畢竟，這些事情需要時間，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Yeah...?
That's alright.
I guess these kinds of things require patience. And thinking.
You know, things I'm horrible at.
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
是嗎...？
沒關係。
我想這類事情需要耐心。還有思考。
你知道的，我在這方面很糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright...!
So what's up?
Hit me up with
what you know~
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
好了...！
那麼，有什麼事嗎？
把你所知道的告訴我吧~

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Hey, this stuff is yours. Think of it as a reward for helping us out. Right, and I'll let Mana know you did a great job. Take care of yourself now~
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
嘿，這些是你的。就當是感謝你的幫忙吧。好了，我會告訴瑪娜你做得很好。照顧好自己哦~

scripts.text:
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation: 有些人覺得沙漠只是一個危險、令人不適的地方，沒人想去那裡。但其實這裡有很多很棒的東西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
We got the blazing heat that encourages skimpy outfits, we got... Cacti. We got more sand than the beach. Um... Sandstorms?
scripts.translation:
[葉爾汗]
我們有鼓勵穿清涼衣服的烈日，我們有...仙人掌。我們有比海灘更多的沙子。嗯...還有沙塵暴？
